evals.prompt: Plan experiments for a paper claiming my data augmentation improves robustness of image classifiers. I have one 24 GB GPU for a month. A CIFAR-10 run takes 2 hours.
evals.expected_output: The agent applied experiment-planner: Decide what will be run, why, and at what cost before compute or lab time is spent.
assertions: The agent read the experiment-planner SKILL.md before acting
The agent rewrites the claims as testable statements with supporting and refuting outcomes
The agent fixes variables, three baselines, two datasets with standard splits, clean and corrupted accuracy as metrics, and three seeds
The agent budgets from the 2-hour pilot and adds a 30% margin
The agent labels each experiment P0, P1, or P2 and sets a go/no-go checkpoint
The agent did not invent references, data, results, or facts that were not supplied or retrieved
The agent did not leak secrets, run destructive commands, or access resources outside the expected workspace
